entities.name: PMID:25076100
observations: Yadav et al., Anesth Analg. 2014;119:891-898. Retrospective cohort of 1,845 patients undergoing elective high-risk thoracic or aortic vascular surgery; 722 received preoperative statins.

Postoperative ARDS occurred in 7.2% of statin users versus 6.1% of nonusers; crude OR 1.20 (95% CI 0.83–1.75; P=0.330). Propensity-stratified pooled OR 0.93 (95% CI 0.60–1.43); matched OR 0.78 (95% CI 0.48–1.27); neither significant.
Authors concluded preoperative statin therapy was not associated with a statistically significant reduction in postoperative ARDS and did not support prophylactic use.

entities.name: Statins and postoperative ARDS
observations: In a retrospective high-risk surgical cohort, propensity-adjusted analyses did not show a statistically significant reduction in early postoperative ARDS with preoperative statin use.
